title: Class 4 spheres seen only during restricted government activities
summary: Skywatcher tells of Class 4 spheres seen only during restricted government activities, about several years (unspecified) at Skywatcher government event sites, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um, class 4 is a sphere. Um, we only saw this several years in a row, when we saw class 4.

plain: A speaker from Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to call UFOs into view, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 about what the team calls Class 4: a sphere. They say they saw these spheres several years in a row, but only at sites where restricted government activities were going on. If true, it would suggest these objects are drawn to, or watching, secret government work.
